title: change
description: One event that changed a post's state or labels, as the source reports it. See contracts/change.md.

id.description: lowercase hex sha256 of the word change, source, target, field, op, value (the empty string when null) and said_at, each followed by a newline except the last

target.description: the id of the post that changed

op.description: the event as the source names it, verbatim, such as closed, reopened, labeled or unlabeled

value.description: the label's name, or the reason the post was closed as the source gives it; null when the event carries none

author.description: the salted hash of who made the change, made as a post's author is; null when the source names no one

fetched_at.description: when the response it came from was received, read from the kept response

private.description: true when it came from a private stream the owner consented to

raw_ref.description: where the raw response it came from is kept, relative to the store
